action: Switch Over time between its two questions, chart and table
user_goal: I want to compare the months, see this month's pace and read my regular costs
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Read Month by month, press Table, then Chart
Press Day by day, then Table, then Chart
expected: Over time has the switch Month by month · Day by day and Chart · Table. Month by month draws stacked columns, spent and still to come, with November marked as the current month; its Table has Month, Spent, Still to come and Total (August 2026 ¥88,780, September ¥150,380, October ¥132,060, November ¥63,450 spent + ¥88,780 still to come = ¥152,230) and its line reads "September was the highest month (¥150,380), mostly because of Hotel Kazemachi Hakone (¥28,600)."

Day by day draws two lines, November and October, as the running total by day, today (Nov 14) marked; the line reads "By the 14th you have spent ¥63,450 in November, ¥59,790 more than October by the same day (¥3,660). October ended at ¥132,060." and its Table has Day, November and October
The question and the look are kept together on this device (D59), separate from This month's, and are still there after the reload
Regular costs follow the panel, as in qa/README U-A

user_goal: I want categories and the business share
